conventions.d2_note: D2 SKIPPED this cycle (owner amendment §3b); the fired census is a pure data census — fired counts only, no candidate returns/PnL
conventions.hold_invariance: H affects only execution legs (clock), not the firing state; fired counts are identical across H within a state; the H variants stay distinct configurations per the frozen §5 grid
conventions.representation: P-12: the EODHD adjusted (total-return) series is THE single representation; adj_ohlc = raw_ohlc x (adjusted_close/close)
conventions.warmup_law: 252 served sessions; first eligible decision >= 253rd served session (0-based index >= 252); a longer construction need wins; warmup attrition censused (F4)
conventions.zero_range_law: a bar with high == low makes RANGE and CLV undefined — the state is NOT FIRED on that bar (fail-closed, never imputed); degenerate bars counted
